answer: The help center doesn't list which lenders are outside the e-payoff network, so it can't give you that list; please check with a store. It only names the network lenders: Bayline Credit Union, Northwind Auto Finance, Meridian Auto Loans, Pinewood Federal Credit Union, Lakeshore Bank and Granite Bank. Granite Bank joined on March 15, 2026, so it is already in the network today. For any lender not on that list, the customer needs to bring a payoff letter or sign form NW-LPA-1 so we can request one, which takes 2 business days.
